{{Quote|Unlike other worlds, holding Kuat's ground is largely meaningless. It's holding the shipyards that matter.|[[Dasken Hobiv]]|<ref name="Insider68">{{InsiderCite|68|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition}}</ref>}}
The '''Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array''', often simply known as the '''Kuat Drive Yards''' or the '''Kuat shipyards''', was a group of connected [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] and completely encircled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] as an immense ring.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Description==
[[File:KDY_Orbital_Array.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Layout of the KDY Orbital Array.]]
The Orbital Array was made of fifteen modules, including three [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that constituted the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and produced some of the most memorable [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These shipyards were the [[Maw Shipyards]], the [[Deponn Shipyards]], and the [[Andrim Shipyards]]. There were also three facilities that played a key role in the function of the ring. The first was the [[Kuati supply space station]], located on the West portion of the Orbital Array, which was responsible for receiving and distributing various supplies required for both creating/maintaining the various warships docked there, and for maintaining the orbital array itself. The second was the [[Kuati residential space station]], located to the north, which acted as living space for the workers at the Orbital Array. The third was the [[military space station]].<ref name="CatCW" />

Owing to the Orbital Array's primary function of laying down, constructing, and maintaining various starships, the ring was littered with various [[Drydock/Legends|drydocks]], warehouses, [[machine shop]]s, and [[Factory/Legends|factories]].<ref name="CatCW" />

As many [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] lived in the ring, the Orbital Array also consisted of many apartment complexes, hotels, restaurants, shops, medical facilities, and places of entertainment. Most of offworlders that visited Kuat remained in the ring during their entire stay. [[Kuati Security Forces]] regularly patrolled all areas within the ring, and as such had multiple [[Kuati Security Forces Headquarters|headquarter offices]] distributed throughout.<ref name="CatCW" />

The Orbital Array had its own weapons systems to defend against hostile starships, although they lacked firepower to destroy [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==History==
{{Quote|Since the dawn of the Republic, Kuat Drive Yards has been the exclusive supplier of many of our greatest warships. Without Kuat to make and repair our fleets, we're vulnerable. Give the planet to the Imperials, and we're finished.|[[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo|Aygo]]|<ref name="TOR:TSW">{{TORcite|exp=starfighter|type=faction|Republic|The Secret War|Carrick Station}}</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a series of fatal collisions halted production at the shipyards. Republic investigators discovered that the automated traffic controller had been sabotaged by Imperial agents. With the help of Republic slicers, the Kuat shipyards were able to repair the traffic control programs and arrested the saboteurs.<ref name="TCM">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Arranged Accidents}}</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] was maintained under repair in the Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array after having sustained heavy damage during an [[Attack on the Rebel Fleet|engagement]] with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]].<ref name="SW13" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]] [[Bombing of the Kuat shipyards (4 ABY)|bombed]] the shipyards to prevent Kuat Drive Yards from falling under control of either the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] or the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shipyards were saved by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] but 20% of the docks were destroyed.<ref name="HM" />

Late during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Kuat was [[Attack on Kuat|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> and the Kuat shipyards were mostly disrupted.<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>
